faq_extra: Where can I get an OBU installed in Singapore?

The workshops listed on this page have done OBU installation, according to Google reviews or their own websites. Tap WhatsApp or Call to confirm that they can fit the OBU on your car before you go. This is not a list of LTA-appointed installation centres.
The on-board unit (OBU) is the in-car device for ERP 2.0 in Singapore. For a car it is usually a processing unit, an antenna and an optional touchscreen, mounted and wired into the car.

wheel-alignment.title: Wheel Alignment Singapore: {n} Workshops, WhatsApp Direct
faq_extra: Is tyre alignment the same as wheel alignment?

Yes. Drivers often say tyre alignment or car alignment when they mean wheel alignment. The workshop measures the angles of the wheels against the maker's settings and adjusts the steering and suspension links; the tyres themselves are not changed.
How do I choose a wheel alignment workshop in Singapore?
Compare the workshops on this page, then tap WhatsApp or Call. Ask whether you get a before-and-after printout of the readings and whether they check for worn suspension parts first.
